notes_for_editor: The brief's status note says NS closed its towers in 2013; the cached CBC text says 2015 and never mentions 2013 (see corrections). The CBC text does not name Johnson Hill; the link to the 2015 decommissioning rests on the 2009 Marscan list, which names it as a DNR tower. The 2000 date in the report title comes from a search listing, not from the cached PDF text, so the story does not state it. No source read describes the site today, the remains, or public access; a local-news or site search could still find this. The NHLR register says staffed each summer as of its 1998 entry, not after.
